description: Creates a new Salesforce Custom Object using the Metadata API. The object name must end with '__c'. Use this when a user asks to create a new object, entity, or table in Salesforce.

autoNumberFormat.description: Format for AutoNumber name field, e.g. 'INV-{0000}'. Required when nameFieldType is AutoNumber.

enableReports.description: Make the object available for reports

fullName.description: API name of the custom object, e.g. 'Invoice__c'

label.description: Singular label shown in the UI, e.g. 'Invoice'

nameFieldLabel.description: Label for the standard Name field, e.g. 'Invoice Name'

sharingModel.description: OWD sharing model for the object

name: sf_create_custom_object
title: Create Salesforce Custom Object
